decision: Close the whole-kernel native-F80 transaction before a numerical prototype: actual remaining uncached BTRAN is too small on both full extended rows. Dense-U scope is below0.22%/0.08% of instrumented solve time for fx/Quad. This is a distinct validation boundary, but it cannot be justified by historical BTRAN shares. No coefficient-maintenance trial, assembly executor, matching-PGO or formal timing screen.
proposal: One staged native U/eta/L numerical transaction with canonical input/constant admission, original binary80 boundaries, one sticky exception check, exact caller CW/SW/MXCSR/live-stack restoration, and complete software fallback from untouched state. Original f64 WORK stays outside and chronological. Earlier per-primitive native checks/TLS validation do not settle this mechanism.
scope_configuration: Isolated ordinary ThinLTO/glibc release-library tests, pinnedRust1.98.1, CPU2. Six small dual-release models capped300 first; then fx5500 andQuad17000. Whole-call timers include out-of-line software arithmetic and original workspace/output/control work, exclude record aggregation. Diagnostic scope, not exact PGO removable time. Both per-Solver caches start with new Vecs; there is no global QuadMain factor cache retained across these solves.

qualification.source_restoration: Entire ftran_order.rs reconstructs literally after removing one test scope object, two branch markers and the module include. Numerical statements unchanged.
qualification.comparison: Complete library SolveResults match own plain same-build solve; all endpoints/caps preserved. Probe is not a candidate optimization; no candidate full987 gate.

independent_review.distinctness: A transaction-wide validation/fallback boundary differs from previously rejected per-primitive checks.
independent_review.conditional_underflow_argument: With nearest-even precision64, exact binary80 subnormals agree with direct F80::pack. Tiny inexact results raise rejected UE. For N=2^-16382 and q=2^-16445, unbounded precision64 rounding to N from below requires z>=N-q/4, inside the direct-format rounding interval z>=N-q/2. Thus that tininess boundary cannot hide a different result. This is a reviewed arithmetic argument, not an implemented/tested native kernel.
required_conditions: Canonical normal/zero operands; no admitted quiet NaNs or noncanonical internal values.
Clear initial status, never clear it during execution; reject IE/DE/ZE/OE/UE, preserve each operation rounding and threshold/duplicate semantics.
Stage all numerical/control/workspace effects until acceptance; restore numerical FP state before committing or falling back.

FXSAVE/FXRSTOR on AMD do not promise identity of otherwise-unused error-pointer fields when ES=0. Do not claim literal preservation of those fields or add two restores based on a potentially incomplete saved image. Mandatory numerical CW/SW/MXCSR/tag/live-stack contract remains separate.
